acquisition.description: Built the four tag binaries offline from a read-only visual-baseline archive copy and ran the tag-era visual_baseline PTY suite (tuisnap run_once / Session.wait_stable) with the snapshots/ store gate bypassed; dumped the settled live Frame cursor per capture. Approved baselines/ and the tag were never written.
acquisition.determinism_spot_check: holla/flows/activities/empty and tablepro/table/cell_editing re-run byte-identical (digest + cursor) to sweep records.
limits: Two combos sampled per root (100x30/truecolor, 80x24/truecolor); position is size-dependent (68/302 identical), visibility is size-stable (302/302 identical).
Cursor style is uniformly Block and blinking uniformly false across all 604 live observations.

Focus and motion have no observation channel in the tuisnap/tuiscotti Frame schema (verified: no such fields); they cannot be reacquired as state. Motion mode is recorded in argv (--motion paused --frame 40) where the suite pins it; focus is implicit in settled cells only.
live-session records (28) come from pointer/live flows with post-boot interaction; argv is recorded as [] with argv_class live-session.
